ja324:3.1:
khāribhāro → ūruṭṭhi bhaggaṃ pavaṭṭito khāribhāro - sabbaṃbhaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇassa bhinnaṃ
bāhāyapaggayyakandati - abhidhāvata haññate brahmacāri – machasaṃ.
ūraṭṭhibhaggā patito khāribhāro - sabbaṃbhaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇassevabhinnaṃ
ubhopi bāhā paggayehavakandati- abhidhāvatha haññati brahmacāriṃ syā
